requirements.requirement: Retain the actual numbered heading 76. 透镜成像作图法. No preceding n75 prose belongs to this new unit.

Retain that focal positions specify the elementary thin-lens model and that object distance and focal length determine image distance without tracing the internal path or drawing the exact spherical surfaces. Preserve the separate converging/diverging symbols in fig177 and fig178 and their caption objects. Literal 图.178 remains in faithful source; modern wording may normalize the reference. Do not infer exact focal-marker fill, arrows, point coordinates or lens dimensions from prose; the image author independently inventories actual source pixels.

Retain point-to-point imaging and hence imaging of the whole object, including the original italic statement. Carry the inherited thin-lens/paraxial approximation and distinguish actual-ray intersections from backward-extension virtual images where necessary; do not approve exact concurrency for all unrestricted rays or silently exclude virtual images from the model.

Retain the original set of three special converging-lens rays and each distinct rule: a ray parallel to the principal axis refracts through the far focus; a ray through the near focus emerges parallel to the principal axis by reversibility; a ray through the optical center retains its direction with a small translation, neglected in the thin-lens approximation. Preserve known foci and optical-center context. Do not turn the real-lens small translation into exact zero or interchange the near and far focus.

Retain the start of constructing the image of AB in fig179, selecting A and sending AC parallel to the principal axis so its refracted continuation passes through the focus. The source ends at 使 with open=true. Do not complete the second ray, claim fig179 source fidelity, or close n76 until actual newly accepted continuation and right-boundary evidence are available.
